title: Spicy Chorizo Tagine
description: A flavorful North African-inspired stew made with spicy chorizo, roasted vegetables, and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chorizo and cook, browning on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add onion, carrots, and red bell pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in garlic, tagine spice blend, and diced tomatoes.
Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until the flavors have melded together and the meat is tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in kissed olives and parsley.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley, if desired.
Serve with couscous or crusty bread, if desired.
